preconditions.description: n is an integer between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(s, str) and len(s) == n and all(c in {'U', 'D'} for c in s)
preconditions.description: s is a string of length n where each character is either 'U' (up) or 'D' (down).

postconditions.description: stdout contains exactly n space-separated integers, where the i-th integer is the dream duration starting from step i+1 (1-based) or -1 if Olga never falls.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(duration, int) for duration in durations)
postconditions.description: Each duration is an integer (either a positive duration or -1).

postconditions.expression: all(duration == -1 or duration >= 1 for duration in durations)
postconditions.description: If Olga falls, the duration is at least 1; otherwise, it is -1.

postconditions.expression: all(duration == -1 or (1 <= start_step <= n and simulate_fall(start_step, s) == duration) for start_step, duration in enumerate(durations, 1))
postconditions.description: For each starting step i (1-based), the duration is the time until Olga falls (or -1 if she never falls). The simulation must follow the rules: Olga moves according to the current pointer direction, and each step's pointer flips after leaving it. Falling occurs if she moves down from step 1 or up from step n.
